code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(v for v in set(sum(grid, [])) if any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid) or any(all(grid[r][c] == v for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)))
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + cols + [w]
    vals = [x for row in grid for x in row if x != sep]
    from collections import Counter
    freq = Counter(vals)
    background = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    target = next(v for v in freq if v != background)
    out = []
    for a,b in zip(rb, rb[1:]):
        line=[]
        for x,y in zip(cb, cb[1:]):
            n=sum(grid[r][c] == target for r in range(a+1,b) for c in range(x+1,y))
            line.append(1 if n == 2 else 2)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
